Study guidelines

Updated 20 November 2026.

A free personal study tool

Honey Scholar helps you practise from worksheets. There are no purchases, subscriptions or paid AI API calls in this app.

Check your source material

Use worksheets you have permission to use. PDF extraction can miss text or misread a layout. Review questions and answer keys before studying. Automated marking checks against the supplied key, not an independently verified answer. AI-generated answers may be incorrect.

Keep assessment rules in mind

This is a personal practice tool, not a proctored exam platform or an official university service. Follow your institution's rules for assessed work. Submitted answers lock for an attempt; retakes count as practice and do not replace the initial score.

Keep a copy

Export important quizzes and account data. Guest progress is temporary, and this student project may change or be unavailable. See privacy and storage for how optional saved data is handled.

Credits and feedback

Report a bug or request an improvement. Do not post private information in public issues.
